[[File:WaterBugs.jpg|230px|thumb|Water bugs of Rori]]
'''Water bugs''' were a swimming species that inhabited the subterranean waterways on the planet [[Mimban/Legends|Mimban]]. These vermin also lived on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]], and [[Rori/Legends|Rori]]. They swam with an anxious, darting motion.
